pages.text: A blast door is a slab of armour plate on a motor: the doors of Cheyenne Mountain weigh twenty-five tons apiece. Heavy plate, a laminated armour glass viewport, a yellow dye for the hazard striping and an electric motor make a blast door.
pages.title: The blast door

pages.text: Placed, it stands three wide and three high in front of you, all of it at once, and needs that much room.

It opens on electricity alone. Its bottom middle block is the drive, an electrical block of The Factory's grid: fed at fifty volts or more, the two leaves slide apart, drawing a motor's load, 24 ohms, while they move and a holding latch's, 480, once open. Cut the circuit and an accumulator shuts them.
pages.title: Power

pages.text: No lever, button, redstone or hand opens it: put a switch in its cable, and keep the switch inside.

It is five times as hard to dig as obsidian, every one of its nine blocks alike, and wants a diamond pickaxe; it stands three times the blast obsidian does. Dig any part and the whole door comes away as one.
